newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil sells virtually all coffee in small auction.
newsitem.headline: Brazil sells virtually all coffee in small auction.

text.p: The Brazilian government sold 29,870 60-kg bags of coffee in its auction today of 30,000 bags of stocks, said an official from the Banco do Brasil which held the electronic auction.
Prices ranged between 97 and 120 ($95.10 and $117.65) a bag, with total income from the sale 3.23 million reais ($3.17 million), the official said.
For some lots, the closing prices were significantly higher than at the opening. For example a lot of 1,500 bags from Uberaba was sold for 120 reais after opening at 106 reais.

Roasters had anticipated there would be good demand in the sale as the freshly-harvested 1996/97 crop is still too young to be included in their blends, and non-government stock supplies of previous crops are tight.
The next auction is scheduled to be held on October 23 and roasters have already asked for the sale to be for a minimum of 100,000 bags.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
